analysis_refs.heading: Technical connector recovery — 6 November 2026
analysis_refs.text: The owner resumed hourly completion work on the fixed 44 technical/unfinished connectors. Two were already working at the start (Open Book Publishers and Helsinki University Press). This pass adds four: NASA Image and Video Library, Lever Press, CaltechTHESIS and Bharat Skills. **Six of the original 44 work; 38 remain open.** A documented failure is not completion.

analysis_refs.heading: Technical connector recovery — 6 November 2026
analysis_refs.text: | NASA Image and Video Library | Use the API explicitly published by NASA (`https://images-api.nasa.gov/search`), whose robots endpoint returns 404, instead of treating the public website’s malformed robots response as an API prohibition | Ten anonymous image-metadata keyword queries, native NASA IDs, empty result and page-two observations. No API key needed; no images/video downloaded. Logos and other rights restrictions still apply. |
